content.short: Bleap is a self-custodial money app for holding and spending stablecoins through a Mastercard debit card.
content.description: Bleap, founded by former Revolut employees, is a self-custodial money app based in Europe that lets people hold and spend stablecoins straight from their own wallet. Through a Mastercard debit card it converts stablecoins such as USDC and USDT to fiat at checkout, so users can pay anywhere while their funds stay on-chain. The app also offers crypto trading, savings with yield, cashback and global transfers. The wallet is deployed on Arbitrum, and its on and off ramps reach networks including Ethereum, Polygon, Base, Optimism, BNB Chain, Solana and Bitcoin. Bleap is backed by investors such as Maven 11 and Ethereal Ventures.
content.meta: Bleap is a self-custodial app to hold and spend stablecoins with a Mastercard card. Discover Bleap and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
